desc.testo: China Overseas Land and Investment Limited (COLI), known as China Overseas, is a Hong Kong–based and incorporated real estate conglomerate. It is an indirect subsidiary of China State Construction Engineering Corporation Limited.
desc.trad: China Overseas Land and Investment Limited (COLI), nota come China Overseas, è un conglomerato immobiliare registrato e con sede a Hong Kong. È una filiale indiretta della China State Construction Engineering Corporation Limited.
